caseName: Gotham Can Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Gotham Can Co. v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Joseph R. Little for petitioner. Solicitor General Thacher, Assistant Attorney General Rugg, and Mr. Claude R. Branch for the United States.

opinions.text: Per Curiam: The petition for a writ of certiorari is dismissed for the want of jurisdiction, because of failure to file the petition within the time prescribed by statute. United States v. Lippman, Spier & Hahn, 260 U. S. 739; Hooper v. United States, 274 U. S. 743; Rust Land & Lumber Co. v. Jackson, 250 U. S. 71, 76.
